summary.en: Vermouth revealed that she has been wandering around the city for some time while disguied as Tsutomu. This allowed Mary's colleagues to spotted Tsutomu and asked Mary to fly back to London, and let three years passed before "Tsutomu" appeared again to avoid suspicion. Mary actually already had suspicion, and had instructed Sera to inform MI6 if she did not make it back in time, and to leave London immediately. Vermouth then wondered if she should disguise as Mary and pay Sera a visit. Mary questioned that, given that Vermouth even did not know her existence until just now. Vermouth then decided to proceed with her objective. She placed the pill on her mouth and kissed Mary, forcing the pill to enter Mary's body. After that, Vermouth wondered how it feet to depart from the world by the poison created by her younger sister. Later, Mary screamed in pain, and fell down from the bridge into the river. Vermouth then quickly left the bridge. Mary managed to went back to the hotel, and tell Sera that she got shrunken. The police later found a large amount of poison on Hanasaki's cake. When Takagi is pointing out the position of Yumi's bag during the murder, he notices a stain on the floor. Sera says that the stain was not there before Hanasaki was killed.
